claims.text: Actual exposed MIS 5e facies are present at Lembetabe, but corresponding sequences in synthetic well logs are sometimes lacking due to preservation bias.
The preservation bias is evident in the progression of sedimentation through the Last Interglacial (LIG) period, where significant lithological sections are removed.
The reef flat correlates to the MIS 5e highstand, indicating the significance of this period in the geological record.
